verdict.rationale: Probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The docs describe NerdGraph as a GraphQL-format API with an interactive explorer, but nothing in the pack documents a downloadable machine-readable spec or exported GraphQL schema. An interactive explorer is an adjacent feature, not a downloadable spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
